data.one_liner: Type-safe Dart DateTime API extensions separating dates, local date-times, and UTC date-times.
data.what_it_does: SuperDates introduces three distinct temporal types (LocalDate, LocalDateTime, and UtcDateTime) to prevent time and timezone bugs at compile-time. It provides clear separation and easy conversion between pure dates, user-facing local timestamps, and server-side UTC timestamps.
use_when: You want to prevent timezone bugs by enforcing correct temporal types at compile time.
Your application needs a strict separation between dates, local date-times, and UTC timestamps.
avoid_when: You are using complex calendar or timezone database calculations not supported by the minimal API.
strengths: Compile-time safety preventing mixing of dates and date-times
Clear distinction between local and UTC time
weaknesses: Limited to basic temporal types and core DateTime integration
Does not handle full timezone database conversions out of the box
